en.title: Full Stack Developer
en.stack: NestJS, Next.js, GraphQL, REST APIs, SQL Server, Azure, Azure DevOps

items: Developed and maintained REST APIs and GraphQL services with NestJS.
Designed and optimized relational databases in Microsoft SQL Server.
Deployed and ran the solutions on Microsoft Azure, with CI/CD, source control and pipelines in Azure DevOps.
Worked with cross-functional teams to align the software with business goals.
